For a classic cheesecake, the best substitute for cream cheese is mascarpone cheese. Mascarpone has a similar rich, creamy texture and mild flavor, though it is slightly higher in fat and less tangy. To mimic the slight tang of cream cheese, you can add a teaspoon of lemon juice or white vinegar per cup of mascarpone. Another option is a blend of full-fat Greek yogurt and butter, but this will result in a lighter, less dense texture that may not hold its shape as well as traditional cheesecake.

Regarding your second question, the animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.
